name: Dolphin Show
description: The crown jewel of Zoomarine and one of the most spectacular marine animal presentations in Europe — the Dolphin Show brings together the park's family of highly intelligent bottlenose dolphins and their dedicated trainers in a breathtaking performance that combines extraordinary athletic leaps, synchronised swimming, acrobatic tail-walking and genuinely moving human-animal connection sequences in a purpose-built marine amphitheatre seating thousands of visitors. The show is carefully designed to combine pure entertainment with powerful conservation messaging about the importance of protecting dolphin populations and ocean ecosystems worldwide. Zoomarine has been home to bottlenose dolphins since its founding in 1991 — the original dolphins Sam and Cher became legendary with visitors and most of the current dolphin family are their descendants. The Dolphin Show is consistently rated the highlight of any visit to Zoomarine and seats fill rapidly — arrive at least 15 minutes before each performance.

name: Dolphin Emotions
description: The most extraordinary and exclusive experience available at Zoomarine — Dolphin Emotions is a premium add-on experience that gives visitors the unique opportunity to enter the dolphin pool and interact directly with Zoomarine's bottlenose dolphins under the close supervision of professional trainers. Available in several formats ranging from a dry-land dolphin encounter to a full 35-minute in-water swim session, Dolphin Emotions is consistently described by visitors as one of the most memorable and moving experiences of their lives — the extraordinary intelligence, gentleness and playfulness of the dolphins at such close range creates connections that guests remember for decades. Zoomarine is the only place in the entire Algarve where you can swim with dolphins. Dolphin Emotions requires a separate ticket and must be booked in advance online as places are strictly limited. Not included in general admission.

name: Sea Lion and Seal Show
description: A genuinely delightful and often unexpectedly hilarious animal show featuring Zoomarine's charismatic sea lions and seals who demonstrate extraordinary intelligence, comic timing and athletic ability in a series of entertaining routines with their trainers. The sea lion and seal show is one of the most audience-interactive presentations at Zoomarine with trainers regularly involving children from the front rows in games and comedy sequences — making it a particular favourite with younger visitors. The conservation messages woven throughout the show about the threats facing wild pinnipeds from plastic pollution and overfishing are delivered with warmth and humour rather than didactic heaviness. Seats fill quickly for this popular show.

name: Birds of Prey Show
description: A magnificent free-flight birds of prey demonstration featuring eagles, falcons, hawks and owls soaring at full speed directly over the heads of the audience in a spectacular open-air arena — the Birds of Prey show at Zoomarine is one of the finest falconry and raptor flight demonstrations available at any Portuguese attraction. The show traces the traditional relationship between humans and birds of prey across centuries of Portuguese and Algarve history while showcasing the breathtaking natural flight capabilities of each species. The falcons in particular reach speeds during hunting dive demonstrations that never fail to astonish audiences. Educational commentary throughout explains the ecological role of birds of prey and the conservation work being done to protect Iberian raptor populations.

name: Magic Rainbow Parrot Show
description: A colourful and joyfully entertaining tropical parrot show staged at the Zoomarine Beach wave pool area where brilliantly coloured macaws, cockatoos and parrots perform extraordinary free-flight sequences under the direction of their trainers — flying spectacularly close over the heads of delighted audience members sitting around the pool. The Magic Rainbow show is one of the most purely joyful and photogenic presentations at Zoomarine and particularly captivates younger children who are thrilled by the vivid colours, the unexpected comedy of the performing parrots and the extraordinary proximity of birds flying centimetres over their heads. Trainers will often position the most sociable birds to land on willing audience members shoulders for photographs.

name: Pirate Acrobatics Show
description: A swashbuckling live-action pirate adventure show that combines high-energy acrobatics, martial arts, comedy and stunt sequences in a theatrical Pirates of the Caribbean-inspired format that consistently ranks as one of the most entertaining live shows at Zoomarine for older children and teenagers. The pirate performers — some on stilts, others performing aerial stunts — engage the audience in a fast-paced comedic adventure story with genuine acrobatic skill and theatrical flair. The show takes place in an outdoor arena and runs multiple times daily throughout the peak season. Particularly popular during Halloween events when the pirate theming takes on a more dramatic and spooky character.

name: 4D Cinema
description: Zoomarine's popular indoor 4D cinema offers two different immersive film experiences with physical seat effects including water sprays, air jets, vibration and leg ticklers synchronised to the on-screen action — one programme is a thrilling and slightly scary adventure film best suited to older children and adults while the second is a gentler and more family-friendly ocean-themed educational adventure suitable for younger visitors. The 4D Cinema provides excellent air-conditioned relief from the Algarve heat during the hottest parts of the day and is one of the most re-watchable attractions at the park. Both films feature impressive ocean and marine life footage.

name: Jurassic River
description: The most popular and beloved ride at Zoomarine — Jurassic River sends visitors on a leisurely and genuinely impressive boat journey through an elaborately themed prehistoric landscape populated by life-sized animatronic dinosaurs lurking in the jungle vegetation, emerging from the water and roaring overhead as boats drift past on the long winding river course. The combination of genuinely impressive dinosaur animatronics, atmospheric jungle theming and the pleasant cooling effect of the water makes Jurassic River the must-do attraction for families at Zoomarine and one of the finest themed boat rides in Portugal. The ride is long enough to be genuinely immersive and the quality of the dinosaur figures is consistently praised by visitors. Min. height: none — suitable for all ages.

name: Zoomarine Beach and Wave Pool
description: One of the largest saltwater wave pools in Portugal — Zoomarine Beach is a magnificent tropical-themed relaxation and swimming area with fine white sand, swaying palm trees, sunbeds, and a generous wave pool that generates gentle rolling waves for a genuinely convincing beach experience deep in the Algarve countryside. The surrounding sandy beach area with its tropical landscaping creates a beautiful and remarkably convincing illusion of being at the seaside and makes Zoomarine Beach one of the most photogenic and relaxing spots at any Portuguese theme park. Multiple food kiosks surround the beach area and the atmosphere is particularly pleasant in the afternoon when the shows have finished and visitors settle in for a relaxed swim. The Magic Rainbow Parrot Show takes place in the beach amphitheatre.

name: Water Slides
description: Zoomarine's exhilarating water slides complex features multiple slides of varying speeds and intensities for all ages — from the high-adrenaline Harakiri where riders sit in rubber boats and rocket down steep drops at maximum speed, to the family-friendly Oceanus tube slides with their twisting tunnels and lightning effects, to gentler slides designed for younger children. The slides are consistently rated among the best water attractions at any Algarve theme park and the variety of experiences from terrifying to gentle means every member of the family finds something perfectly suited to their thrill threshold. The slides are most popular during the afternoon heat and queues can build — morning visits are recommended.

name: Rio dos Cocos
description: A wonderfully relaxing lazy river ride where visitors float along a gently flowing current in rubber rings through a beautifully landscaped tropical course with palm trees, exotic plants and cooling water features. Rio dos Cocos is the perfect counterpoint to the more energetic attractions at Zoomarine — a genuinely refreshing and peaceful way to cool down and recharge between shows and more active rides. The tropical theming throughout the river course creates a pleasant and convincingly exotic atmosphere. Suitable for all ages and one of the most family-friendly water attractions at the park.

name: Iguacu Rapids
description: A thrilling circular river raft rapids ride themed to the famous Iguazu Falls of South America — Iguacu sends groups of visitors spinning and bumping through churning white water rapids, past dramatic rockwork waterfalls and through tropical jungle scenery in a guaranteed soaking river adventure. Named after one of the natural wonders of the world, Iguacu captures the wild energy of the South American jungle and delivers the kind of completely chaotic and unpredictable water ride experience that families remember long after the visit. The group format in circular rafts means the soaking is equally distributed and entirely democratic. Min. height: 100cm.

name: Aqua Tube Slides
description: A family-friendly water slide complex featuring enclosed tube slides of various speeds and lengths that send riders through twisting dark tunnels with coloured lighting effects before delivering them into a splashdown pool at the bottom. The Aqua Tube slides are particularly popular with children aged 6-14 who love the enclosed tunnel experience and the anticipation of not knowing exactly when the splashdown is coming. Multiple slides run parallel to each other allowing family groups to race down simultaneously. A gentler alternative to the more intense Harakiri and Oceanus slides. Min. height: 110cm.

name: Buffalo Roller Coaster
description: Zoomarine's most thrilling mechanical ride — Buffalo is a compact but surprisingly punchy family roller coaster that sends riders through a series of dips, turns and small drops in a western buffalo stampede theme. Buffalo is the most intense traditional amusement ride at Zoomarine and while modest by major theme park standards is genuinely exciting for younger visitors experiencing their first coaster and provides a fun adrenaline hit for adults in between the marine shows and water attractions. Queue times can build in the afternoons — best tackled first thing in the morning. Min. height: 120cm.

name: Farol Drop Tower
description: A dramatic free-fall drop tower themed to a Portuguese lighthouse — Farol sends riders shooting upward to the top of the tower before releasing them in a sudden terrifying free-fall drop that delivers maximum adrenaline in minimum time. The lighthouse theming is charming and authentically Portuguese and the elevated platform at the top of the tower provides genuinely impressive views across the Zoomarine park and the surrounding Algarve countryside during the brief pause before the drop. A compact but effective thrill ride that provides the biggest pure adrenaline hit available at Zoomarine. Min. height: 120cm.
